== Summary ==
Identified: [[Mark Peterson]]. Caption names the winner.

== Description ==

Tournament winner [[Mark Peterson]]. At the [[May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (25 May)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 25 May 2003.
